---
title: Merge count tables
description: Combine per-sample HTSeq outputs for downstream analysis.
---

After all tasks finish successfully, merge the count tables:

```bash
htseq-count-cluster merge --directory counts
```

The output, `counts/merged_counts_table.csv`, begins with `Genes`, followed by
sample columns sorted by count-table filename.

Each `*.counts.tsv` file requires two tab-separated columns, unique gene
identifiers, and identical gene order. Mismatches stop the merge, preventing
missing or misaligned counts. HTSeq summary rows such as `__no_feature` remain
for downstream assignment-quality checks.
